theorem lg_target : (Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) (Finset.range 30)).card = 10 := by
  let nums := Finset.range 30
  let filtered := Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) nums
  have h1 : filtered.card = nums.card / 3 :=
    by rw [Finset.card_filter, Nat.div_eq_floor]; exact (Nat.floor_div_eq_div_of_non_neg _ _).symm
  have h2 : nums.card = 30 := rfl
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact h1
